title: Yoga Studio: Stretch on the Go

reviews.text: Didn't get the classes I paid for. I paid the one time membership years ago, and they allowed me to have a few basic classes. As soon as they stopped offering that option and instead only offered monthly subscriptions, they removed all of the classes I had paid for.

My go to. When I am
Really feeling stiff, I go to my classes. I have 4, 3, 15 minute, and 1 10 minute. I always feel
geat after completing them!
Scam. Just paid for the 12 months access, but the app didn’t open up the paid content. I can only access free content even after I paid.

Long term contender. I’ve had this app for several years now and it’s stood the test of time. I made a purchase a long time ago and they’ve held true to the restored purchases throughout its life too! Appreciated. I enjoy the voices, calmness, and consistency of the videos and I really like the variety. All in all, I STILL turn to it over trying to find a YouTube video. 😊
Why Do I Have To Pay Now. When my dad first had this happen in 2016 everything was free. Now I can’t do a single thing without it asking me to pay.

Chill vibes great workout. I have been using this app on and off for years. The workouts are calm and range from super easy beginner to skilled. But what is really great is that you can preview the workout before you start it and see all the moves so you know what to expect. You aren’t trying to follow some fitness “yogi” yelling ambiguous directions at you over “cool tunes.”

Good app but drains battery. The app does what it says and has all the right features. However, you pretty much need to plug your phone into the charger if you’re doing more than 15m of yoga. I lose about 1% a minute using this app on my iPhone 16.
Intermediate Combination, 30 minutes. Easy to follow and can do it on my schedule!

Awesome. I can do my practice anytime & anywhere I choose. Loads of classes to choose from. Pleasant voices & sounds. Love it!
Don’t change it please!

So thankful. I’ve used this app since 10 years. I love this app. I can practice yoga anywhere everywhere. It leaves me feeling great and it does what a yoga app should do. I do feel like I completed a yoga class after every session. Thank you Yoga Studio for the countless hours you’ve contributed in my life.

Poor Customer Service. I purchased this app back when it was a one time fee, at the very beginning of the app starting. I had an issue with one of the previous updates but the was able to get it resolved. With the most recent update, I am having issues again. I reached out to the app support and have heard nothing. The app is great when it works. I’d consider a different app with better support though. When

Great app. Have been using for more than 10 year. I bought this app over 10 years ago and it’s so good. There are a lot of great workouts on it, but I still find myself going back to the ones that were on it when I first got it.

Hate the red banner on bottom of opening screen. It’s also strange that even though the custom classes use an avatar, she doesn’t turn in the direction that the voice dictates - seems like that would be an easy fix.

Feeling Strong. I love that I am strengthening my body and quieting my mind at my own pace in my own space! When I travel, it’s always possible to keep it up. I’m so grateful for the strength and agility these classes bring to me.

Terrific and for everyone. I’ve been using this app for years and in many ways it has given me the support I needed to move. In 2023 after years of seeing dr’s and no one could diagnose me. I checking myself into the Mayo Clinic, and found out that what I needed was my hips replaced. The dr’s were shocked at how bad my hips were and that I was still walking. The reason I was able to walk is because I used this app almost everyday. 3 years later I’m now in the best shape of my life and I’m in my 60s. This app helped me heal and become my healthiest self.

THIS Is The One. I always come back to this yoga app. I’ve tried others, but they always seem to irritate me and aren’t relaxing or meditative. This app, especially the classes taught by Jules, is challenging yet calming and allow me to truly focus inward on my practice.

KEVIN FLYNN IS THE BEST!. I have been practicing Kevin’s Posture yoga for a few months now and my days are better for it. Old stubborn hip and lower back pain slowly vanishing. All of Kevin’s classes amazing! Thank you Kevin!
Great Yoga workout. I used it in hotels while traveling and it helps with the stress of every day work plus the background music is amazing and relaxing. Love it!!!

Love it! ❤️. Love this app! I have been using it for years now to help myself recover from a massive stroke I had at 28yo. My body always feels amazing and I feel like I can function more like me after every session.

Love Yoga Studio. I am truly not sure how I would live without the ability to pop a yoga class on my TV in this busy life. Love all the classes and the ability to pick all different varieties, short, medium and long. Always new things being added. Love you will all my heart Yoga Studio 🙏❤️

Great Yoga Workout. I have been using this App for at least 15 years. I have never gotten beyond the beginning workouts, and have even stopped doing yoga for a few years at a time. But every time I come back to it the app starts right up, no ads, same routines I love. They got it right the first time and it is still perfect for me!

Good classes. I have been using this app for many years now it's so convenient and so informative that I don't feel the need to be in a group setting. I could concentrate at home alone in a room with this app and really think about my movements and how I feel and I find this very safe and encouraging to just compare myself to myself in terms of my work as a yoga student. I highly recommend this app and they have new classes very often that can alsoencourage a variety of forms and interest for any other student.
Great build tool. I like that I can build my own workout, this is my favorite part of this tool. The new updates are useful as well.

Jumbled mess. App is good but not great. Most of the stuff is just a jumbled mess you go from the beginning class to an intermediate class and there’s stuff that has never been talked about or shown. both the beginning and intermediate classes have far advanced stuff for most people, as well as no explanation of how to get to these things and even be able to do them. Also, most of the reminders of how not to do something come after doing the pose the second time which is stupid. Also, there are no modifications to anything for people with bad shoulders and almost everything is 100 and around downward dog over and over and over again I understand that this is an essential part of yoga, but there should be modifiers and other classes that don’t involve 100% downward dog all the time
Morning yoga. Before work I enjoy the 15 minute classes, it starts my day feeling more awake
Wonderful app. This app promotes a peaceful feeling and supports progress toward greater well-being. Classes by Kevin highly recommended!

Just don’t work. I downloaded this app with great hopes, I wanted something to remind me to do a bit of yoga each hour, and once a day. Not only does it not do that, the app screen goes completely blank as soon as I move it to my secondary monitor. So from my perspective the app is simply broken and non-functional. I went to the website through report an issue on Apple, and the website is also down saying Website Expired. I suspect this might be a dead app now.
Yoga App Happy. I've been using this app for a few years and still find it beneficial. The app has updated yet continues to offer the classes I love.

Great til I got my MAC. I love this program. Keeps me moving. I just wish the app had the same home screen on my new MAC laptop as it does on my iPhone 12 and iPad mini. They both have a selection for my programs that I’ve been using for years. Not the MAC. Some of my favorites are there but others like my very necessary “Twist and Align “can’t be found.
Best yoga app by far!!!. Excellent class options! Very easy to use! Love this app!!
Excellent app. It’s a outstanding app, just perfect it
Jules yoga sessions never age. The creator of this app, Jules (in purple shirt and black leggings), made such fantastic yoga routines long time ago and till today they are the best.

Don’t get all the good reviews. Not great UI design. None of the videos in sections are in order, for example, the leg focused section is supposed to be for a 6 week plan, but when you go to it the “videos” are out of order, which was already hard to figure out because none of them are labeled with numbers. On top of that, you can’t actually watch any of the videos without downloading them. They can literally just set it up with embedded YouTube videos to a private channel, but instead you have to download each video to be able to watch it.
Yoga for anyone!. This app has been my go to for timed sessions, expanding into new poses and meditation practices for nearly 7 years! Great offering!
So calm..... Great app. Loved it when it was first released, dislike the current cost and the new classes- not worth the cost to me.
Must Have. Yoga Studio is and has been my go-to app for my Yoga and mobility training for years, and they just keep improving the app! Five Stars!
The app died. I lost all saved sequences with no explanation

I love it. I hav e been using this for 7 year now. I simple get the best yoga at any time anywhere, i can do it by myself at my own pace while listening and been guided. Its most beneficial when I got for a run and have to stretch afterwards.
Best yoga App. I have been using this app for 10 years and it continues to grow and offer new yoga techniques and styles . My favorite is the beginner series though because of the instructor.

Hands Down, The Best Yoga App. Love this yoga app! So many options to adjust to different focus areas, your skill level, energy level, and time available. Only 1 complaint, the calendar is crazy glitchy. I love using the built in calendar to schedule my classes ahead of time. Firstly, while looking at the class you like, it won’t let me select a day/time to schedule it. It’s stuck on the current day/time. So I go the calendar to add from there, I schedule 1 class for the day, but now it shows 2 or 3? Of the same class, at the same time? If you delete one, the whole app crashes and the entire calendar deletes?!?! Every class scheduled for every day is gone. Gotta start over, UGH!
Excellent. Excellent app. Great variety of yoga sessions. Love it.
Don’t buy. This product was great until it stopped working AND customer service and technical support has been nil. I’ve been trying to get help for six months. Don’t buy!
Still doesn’t connect with iOS Health. I’ve asked about this 2x before- so please get it fixed!

I love it!. Perfect companion, I love the sequence of poses, the classification of sessions and that I can choose between 15 and 60 minutes sessions. I’ve been using this app for almost two years and I love it very much.
Used to be a great app. Impossible to sign in after upgrading account. Finding classes locked that I’ve been doing for 10 years. Frustrating!
Estupenda aplicación. Best yoga app by far!!

Graceful Instruction. I use apps all the time. I especially love Yoga Studio. The instructions are done in a way that honors the yoga traditions. The pictures are helpful and tasteful. They are presented in a non-competitive, meditative manner. Never are the images distracting or immodest. Thank you for years of consistent professionalism.
Excellent. This is a a beautiful app
Jules is a great teacher. Top
Best Yoga app…hands down. For many years, Yoga Studio has been my trusted foundation. Despite exploring various classes and apps, I invariably return to my preferred platform.
Life goal. Complete the advanced series with Jules

Love Beginner Flexibility. I’ve been using Yoga Studio for 5+ years. I always do the same flow, Beginner Flexibility. It stretches your whole body, especially your legs and hips, and I think it’s an absolutely perfect flow. I highly recommend this app and the Beginner Flexibility flow!
Yoga for real. An outstanding app that offers many variable challenging practices from beginner to advanced. Really an amazing app that never disappoints

Barely Functional. I used to like this app a lot but the newest release is barely functional on iOS 18 point whatever. I like the Yoga for Runners series but navigating through the app to specific workouts is a daunting procedure. Typing Yoga for Runners in the search bar goes to a dead link. It takes a search of all classes to find it, and the bookmark feature for these sessions doesn’t seem to work either. I’d rather not download the classes to my phone but that may be a workaround I have to try or find a more user-friendly yoga app. I appreciate the expanded menu of classes but the cost of that update seems to be diminished and more difficult access to the classes I want to use.

Lost my account - will be deleting. New phone - restored backup but this app doesn’t remember my account and my settings. Time to move on and delete this. Once upon a time it was a good app. 

The ever ongoing battle with GAIM’s unfettered greed.

Bad update. Been avoiding updates, mistakenly hit button. Awful! I 
lost entire app, had to reinstall everything. Confusing layout, barely visible info harder to find what I want. Basic essentials good, but a lot of stuff of no interest whatsoever.

Love the classes, really dislike the redesign. I’ve been a subscriber since 2019 and have loved the classes and the simplicity of the design of both the app and the plain, simple backdrop of the classes themselves. The redesign is a big step down. Classes are harder to find and sort, and the large, meaningless banner images do nothing except frustrate my search for classes. What had been an easy and stress free interface (on the iPad) is now unnecessarily irritating and full of extra clicks to get where I want to go. The social tools (like comments) are annoying, a reminder of a noisy and chaotic reality, and take away from the old straightforward focus of the app. Not excited for the direction this once extremely useful and soothing app is going in.
Must have!. With the weekly running and weight training, I feel that I must practice with this Yoga program to relax the body and help the muscle grow! It is such a wonderful feeling afterwards!
Great app!. Great app! Download your favorite workouts and they ‘ll play anywhere, no internet connection needed. Been using for about 10 years.
Best yoga app. I bought this app when it had only one class. I love it! Simple and relax class. Even 15 minutes yoga makes feel better
تطبيق رائع جدا وممتاز. جسدي يتشافى مع اليوغا
Yoga for any”body”. I really enjoy this app and it’s instructors. Multiple options for anyone. No excuses!

At A Finger Tap. Yes, at a finger tap: you can access Yoga Studio for whatever mood or class you might need at that given moment. Easy to follow relaxing music and a great workout with you have 15 minutes. 30 minutes. Or an hour. Always tap away.

Long time user. I’ve been using this app for a long time, somewhere between 5-10 years. Love this app, I always feel better after a doing a class, plus they’re easy to follow along. I mainly use it after running which has helped me with post run recovery. Highly recommended.

Older yogis with Osteoarthritis. These classes are great. However as a 35+ year yogi, I find very few classes are geared to yogis with osteoarthritis. We can’t go as fast as we used to and have more pain. Kevin has a yoga for posture that is GREAT, but their is very few others. I am 74 and want to continue my practice till I die, but older peoples needs are different than young people.

New version and format are terrible. Yoga studio has long been my main way of doing yoga. The classes are great. However, a few months ago the app was revised with a new layout, organization and interface. Pretty much everything about this new version is terrible and certainly worse than it was. I wish they would throw it out and go back to the previous layout.
Free routines are great.. I’m using the free routines to spark my practice of daily yoga.

Thanks for the duration. I was ready to leave the app, but the latest update which returned the duration of the classes to “my classes” is the change I needed to stay. Now, as before, I can see at glance which class I want to take based on its length as well as level and focus, and this saves me time from hunting and pecking to find the right class and makes my experience better

Great App!. I’ve used this app since it was released and it’s definitely the best yoga app available. Love it! Recent updates screwed it up. For example, you could no longer sort your classes by duration which was one of the most useful features. Luckily Yoga Studio realized their mistake and fixed it. Hurray! Thank you!!

Yoga Studio saved my life. In 2013 my husband deployed to Afghanistan. We were living in an apartment in Arlington Va. About 2 months into his deployment I got dreadful news, I had cancer. I was terribly out of shape but knew I needed to be as strong as possible to fight. Enter Yoga Studio. When I first started, I couldn’t even reach me knees when doing a foreword fold! Long story short, my husband returned home safely after 6 months, I’m cancer free, and yoga still plays a big part of my life. I recommend this app to all my friends and family and to whoever will listen. I just returned to the app after being away for a bit but I’m so happy with all the new classes! I recommend the 15 minute relaxation yoga before bed! It works like a charm!

Paid full price before can’t access now. Update 2025: I updated my iPad and now can’t access the app. I got this 8 years ago. I was also logged out on my iPhone. It looks like it updated the app and it logged me off and now I can’t go back in without having to pay for subscription. Please correct this.
 -
2018: I am so disappointed. I bought this app before but have stopped using it because I got so tied up with work. Now, I’m trying to access and it’s asking me to pay for subscription. I clicked on already a member and also clicked on Restore but both did not work. To think,I even paid for this twice before because I had to change my Apple ID. I like the app so much and have even saved some classes in my previous Apple ID. Now, I’m just so disappointed!

What happened??. I’ve had this app for as long as it came out before subscriptions. It was $10. They updated to a crappier UI, and the awesome custom stretches I’ve had for YEARS are gone. I don’t get how an awesome app gets worse in almost 10 years if not longer.

Awesome and simple to use. I was surprised that it was straight forward and easy to use. You’ll need to download the programs however it’s good because it’ll save for you. I am grateful for this app. Let’s go!

Can’t access previously purchased content. I bought this app for $3.99 in 2016 and now I can’t access what I’ve purchased. I’ve had this problem before. What the heck is wrong with this company? Like seriously - just stop trying to lure me into ripoff paywall

Good home app. The app is ok. There are many classes to choose from, which is nice. It’s difficult to find favorite classes in the new user interface. Not sure if my old favorites are gone or that I just haven’t found them again. The workout tracking is inaccurate. It used to be easier to use. Now I only use it occasionally because it’s frustrating not being able to find a class that I’ve always enjoyed

Disappointing app Tracking and subscription issues. Years ago I was happy with Yoga Studio, but apps change. The price went up and the app had to disclose that it wants to track you. Namaste indeed! I just downloaded the app again to give it another try. It offered me a 7 day trial, but when I accepted it charged my credit card immediately. Not OK! This is shady behavior. I guess I’m going elsewhere for yoga….

Love Yoga Studio. The classes help me so much! I have MS and the classes offered by Yoga Studio help me with flexibility which in turn help with pain. As I turn older, I know I have to keep moving and Yoga Studio makes doing that easier. The classes are easy to understand and the instructors are wonderful. I highly recommend Yoga Studio.

Yoga App review. IDO NOT like the new format.. I have all these classes that say they are incomplete at 98% even though I finished them. There is no way to delete them from my classes that I can find. And there are many classes that were downloaded into my class from the old format with no way to delete. The start button is way to the right not easy to access to start. I used to recommend this app frequently and I will not until it changes again.
Great app. Wide range of video for any level of skill.

1 star - formerly 5 stars. Atrocious update - ruined the app . Everything about this app used to be perfectly designed and functional , now it’s clunky and disfunctional at every turn. The “My Classes” section is a disorganized mess with no sorting options, photos are stretched out or unnaturally cropped, download and play buttons are drifting half off the screen, I could go on and on. The company seems unresponsive and oblivious, so I will be looking for a new yoga app .

Love this app, but…. I have loved this app for years, but the new interface is not ideal for those of us who sometimes want a quick fix (15 minutes) or a longer session (45 minutes). There is a time search, but it was previously so much more intuitive.

Really great app. I’ve used this app for years. They’ve added a bunch of new routines and features over the years, but their original basics classes and ability to design. Your own yoga sets is fantastic. Straightforward, clean and easy to follow..

So Easy to Personalize!. I was a beginner & had no idea where to start. This app let me create my own routine, & edit it over and over until I had one that worked for me. You can adjust the length a pose holds, the order of the poses, and which poses you want. Years later & Im still using it! And I mean Years later! Still a huge fan for the ability to create my own yoga session. Love it.

Great classes but no support. I have had this app for Years and I absolutely love the yoga classes and options. However the app has never worked to track my stats for keeping track of my progress even though there are areas for that. Mine say I’ve done 0 yoga even though I do it daily. I’ve contacted customer service multiple times to try to fix this and they acknowledge they get the email and tell me it will be fixed in the next update. It never happens. This latest update also is disappointing as now you can’t see how long each class is without clicking into it and the way it’s listing your classes is disorganized and cluttered. My advice to them, keep it simple and fix your stat tracker. (Mine literally says I have done 361 classes in a row but 0 minutes of yoga.
Best yoga app. This is the best yoga app hands down. Down Dog is close second.

I updated the app. And it works now.
I paid for this app a long time ago, and it quit working for a while but the latest update helped. Thank you! I was about to give up on it and delete it.
Love!. I love using this app several times per week outside. So much more relaxing and easier than driving to a class. Highly recommend!

Used to love this app. I loved that this app allowed you to create your own classes. I have over 20 classes that I created and I had them organized but now there is no way to organize them. This makes it hard for me to find the class I’m interested in. Yes, all of the in app classes are great, but give me back a way to organize mine.
Variety and range are great. Always can find a session that I need in length and focus. Nice to see different instructors too

11 years I have owned this content only for it to be stolen. I purchased this app 11 years ago and today an update has stolen what I purchased.

Edit: another update has restored my access to the content I purchased 11 years ago. As my property was restored I will change my rating from the one star that was earned, however I can not in good faith return to the 5 stars that I had before this theft situation. I am turning off updates and I will continue to ignore all new content. I am here for the purple shirt lady stuff that I bought.
Changes not helpful. Recent revisions to the app are not helpful. It’s harder to find classes. Specifically, on the my classes tab, I have multiple classes that have the name “beginner flexibility”.

Update is a miss. I’ve been using this app for 10+ years and have always had great things to say about it. I’ve watched the app change and expand over the years and continued to recommend it to everyone who would listen. However, this recent update is a miss. The interfaces are less organized, harder to navigate, and overall much less user friendly. I will continue to use the app as I love the content so much, but I’m hopeful for the next update to rectify these issues and bring the app back to its previous standard of functionality.

Change it Back!. I have used yoga studio for YEARS! The new so called update is horrendous. I can’t access the instructor or classes that I used to love. The list is there, but only for 60 minutes and I have always done 30 and want to continue to do so. I find it very frustrating to change for the sake of change, when it was working fine.

New update. I loved this app before it was overhauled a couple months ago. Now it is difficult to navigate and not user friendly, which is disappointing because the content is unmatched and incredible.
Dislike new Update. I really don’t like the new version. I had my classes custom sorted by time, focus, and teacher, and all that got blown away. Now you have to try to guess which class is which.

Disappointed with recent updates. I've used and loved Yoga Studio for years, but don't love the recent changes to "My Classes" - no longer able to easily see length of classes on that page and cannot arrange classes.

Poor update. Please bring back the class length on the description. Please make the display brighter for aging eyes. New version is harder to navigate. This has always been a solid product I’ve used it for 10+ years, but this version makes me want to look elsewhere.
Love the choices. So grateful for yoga studio a framework for home practice. I’m impressed by the choices. It’s an integral part of my weekly routine.
New format. I don’t like the new format. I find it difficult to select the class I want based on time.

Not Keen on New Format. The new format is awkward and not user friendly. The duration of classes is not easily identifiable and photos are distorted and cut off. Searching for classes is more cumbersome. I much prefer the cleaner format of the older version.

Full purchase. I purchased a full version back in the day when that was a thing and I only have limited access. I get that things have been added since going to the subscription model but it seems less functional and there is no design your own class option now I don’t think. Plus how many people out of all the subscribers bought the full version when it was available…just be nice and let us have full access like we paid for….

Awful design update. I’ve been using this app since it first came out and loving it. For years, this was a beautifully designed app. When it first came out over a decade ago, its minimalistic and elegant interface was ahead of its time. The most recent update makes this app look like it’s from 90s, if such a thing were possible. It’s cluttered and hideous, and essential information about individual classes is no longer easily visible. Whomever you hired to make you this design owes you a refund and you owe us, your users, an update that makes this app’s interface usable again.

Terrible redesign. Everything on this redesign of this app looks terrible. The graphics are squished and look atrocious. Things are hard to find. And the layout of the pictures makes no sense. The positioning of some of the graphics actually makes things look perverse.

Hate the update!. I have used this app for over a decade. I love(d) this app. One of the few apps I have consistently loved, used, and raved about. The recent update is absolutely HORRIBLE! I have no idea why anyone thought this latest layout was a good idea. It’s so bad. The layout before was so user friendly (specifically the session times being easily accessible). I’m really bummed by this, and for the first-time ever thinking of replacing it.
New phone- app doesn’t work. I’ve used this app for 10 years. I just got a new phone and my go-to sessions won’t load or play 😭

More disappointment. I guess I should stop judging this app against how it was originally when I first paid for it. The people coming to this app now see it so differently. The newest update doesn’t include time on the classes, and just has my classes as a long long list of all my downloads. I have Three Intermediate Strength classes - 15, 30, and 60 minutes. How do I know which is which? I have to open them all until I find the one I’m looking for, and the time is so little and hidden in an obscure corner. I would much prefer a “legacy” app that would just allow me to keep doing what I’ve been doing. Or maybe it’s time to me to just let this app go. 

I finally broke down and paid for the subscription, after vowing not to when Gaiam happened and they took away the app I had loved for years. So, I’m less mad and wanted some new classes, especially yin and restorative. I just tried the “yin for stress” - and wow - it makes me think they really don’t know what they’re doing. I’ve been practicing yin for more than 10 years. One does not do arm balances during yin! (Nor warrior poses, nor vinyasas) Yin is a passive practice, with long-held poses. There is one (short) yin pose at the beginning of this class and the rest is more like a modified vinyasa with props - one breath for every pose (including bakasana). I just don’t know, Yoga Studio. You keep letting me down. Maybe you should google and see what yin classes really look like? Cause that’s what I’m gonna do.

Updated app disappointing. After using this app for well over a decade I have to say the updates to this app are disappointing. The duration times per session are hard to locate. This app is now way over complicated then it needs to be.

New Format for App is Lousy. The new format for the app is not easy to use. It looks nice but it is harder to find the classes that I prefer. I particularly miss seeing the length of the class when searching for a class. Sometimes I have only a short amount of time and need a short class. I think once I found a way to filter on time but I have not been able to find it again. I spend more time trying to find a class on this app than I actually practice yoga. Go back to the old format, the new format is pretty but it is useless.

I use Yoga Studio all the time. I love yoga Studio. It’s very convenient. I can do it anywhere I like. It is more convenient than going to a class. And cheaper.

However, they seem to have updated the app. It’s inferior to the previous version. I used to be able to sort my workouts by duration. And they make it harder for me to find the instructor that I like because she does not appear in the list of instructors. I don’t know what they were thinking, but I’m disappointed in the product’s direction.

Worst update. I’ve been using Yoga Studio for years and loving it. The new update is awful! I can’t put my classes in the order I want them, when I look at my studio I can’t see the length of each class at a glance without opening the class, the calendar is not as user friendly, I cannot look at a whole month and easily see what I did each day. I used to be able to do all of these things with the old version. As much as I love these classes this new update is making me think about looking for a new app. 🙁

A long and complex journey. 2024 

This journey began January 7, 2013, when Yoga Studio was suggested by the App Store, or maybe a media website, with recommendations for the new year. At $2, I thought I would give it a try.

I have only tried three or four beginners classes, and currently use it to keep track of daily stretches.

Soon the app was bought out, and turned into a subscription program using the same name. 

Biggest con: original purchasers have struggled to have access.

Biggest pro: without app updates, this would have died out as App Store requirements demand app changes often.

I cannot comment on what subscribers receive. There seems to be a lot of content they can choose from. At my age, I probably need more Tai Chi and less Yoga.

2019

Just restarted using on a regular basis. I have not subscribed, but am using the original one time cost level from early 2012 or so. From what I receive, it is enjoyable. I once again feel instructed.

Being at a beginner level, subscriptions are not a thought. However, subscriptions seem too expensive.

I think this once again is at a five star level. Keep in mind it is five stars for the one time lower level cost, with an optional upgrade only.

 -

2017 - part 2
It may have been restored. Maybe I should try it again. Marking up to four now.

------

2017 Haven't used it in three years
Now expecting to pay again? Sorry but one is to pay monthly for real yoga.

Uninstalled. Bye.

From 2014 or so

Two major downsides: 1. The custom classes aren’t easily usable from one device to another. The file of the custom class I created must be downloaded from the device I was using then emailed to myself so it can be uploaded to the new device I want to use. This presents a huge problem for the AppleTV devices I use if I want to practice yoga in front of a TV screen as I do not have email set up on my AppleTV devices. Terribly inconvenient.

2. Now that I have practiced for a few years, I can distinguish between the beginner, intermediate and advanced versions of some poses. But so-called beginner poses in the app are demonstrated as advanced when they don’t need to be. For instance, the “shoelace pose” in the app demonstrates the yoga model performing the pose with a “forward fold,” which is difficult for a beginner. In my opinion, there should be 2 versions, one which includes shoelace pose sitting upright for a beginner and an intermediate one, which is “shoelace pose with forward fold.” Consequently, I think the yoga model needs to show the beginner and intermediate versions of the same pose as to limit injury.

I would likely recommend this app to more to my friends and family who need a good guide for yoga if both these issues were to be addressed properly. I’m afraid the confusion over file uploads and downloads is a negative. Also, showing a forward fold on a beginner pose not described as such is problematic.
